tests pass. I can't see the hidden tests.

The README asks for exactly two decimal places, but it also says `parseNear(formatNear(x))` must equal `x` for every input. Those two conflict for amounts with more than two significant decimals, such as `1.234` NEAR. I resolved the conflict in favour of the round-trip rule: trailing zeros are stripped, then the fraction is padded back out to two places. An amount like `1.234` NEAR therefore prints with all its digits rather than being rounded to `1.23`. If the hidden tests expect strict two-place rounding for such amounts, this will fail them.
